key_idea: Count which cubes are already used. The one left over goes on the ?.
steps: In the wall we can see 2 red, 2 blue and 1 green cube.
Nora has 3 red, 2 blue and 1 green. So 1 red cube is still left, and she uses all of them.
The left over red cube goes on the ?. It touches the green cube on its right and the blue cube below it, so no red cubes touch.

choice_feedback.B: Both blue cubes are already in the bottom row.
choice_feedback.C: The only green cube is already used, right next to the ?.
choice_feedback.E: Only 1 red cube is left, so the colour is certain.
